facts.fact: The tabled 2026 finance bill (proposed, not yet enacted) names FCFA 874,046,000 for programme 380 Modernisation du cadastre (national digital cadastre) under the Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure, financed from domestic revenue.

systems.owner: Ministry of State Property, Surveys and Land Tenure

note: Proposed bill, not a passed budget; digital status rests on the programme's stated objective of a digital national cadastre.
